response.sql: WITH race_circuits AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_averages AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_average_round FROM race_circuits GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_average_round FROM race_circuits GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_average_round, ca.circuit_average_round - co.country_average_round AS difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country IS co.country ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
